entities.title: Typed layer
entities.summary: The typed API of library 0.3: CivilDate, CivilYearMonth, CivilTime, CivilDateTime, FixedOffsetDateTime, ZonedIntent, Instant, Period, PosixSeconds, ElapsedSeconds and Interval<T>, with Outcome<T>, the typed policies and TemporalContext.
entities.purpose: Gives each everyday UTV value its own immutable type, valid by construction, so that total operations return plain values and only partial ones return an Outcome<T>. It is what the README and the example tests show. Each operation builds the value's JSON, calls the JSON-layer function in the parent folder and converts the UtvResult back.
boundaries: Holds no arithmetic, parsing or zone logic of its own: Calendar, Zones, Ranges, TextForm and Interop in the parent folder answer every question.
Holds only the everyday shapes; any other valid UTV value is unsupported (unsupported-operand) and stays in the JSON layer.
Everything is in namespace Utv, as the JSON layer is.
